method: Reviewed all 18 INIT setup screenshots: token, PostgreSQL, Redis and administrator at 1440/1280/768/390, plus the 390 PostgreSQL error and service-switch states. Password and email fields are masked. No overflow, clipped actions, or raw internal values.
checks: Token step explains setup-token, --init reload, and --setup without a second credential file
PostgreSQL defaults are gate/gate, SSL label is Chinese, and the error keeps both actions visible
Redis step shows ACL user migate and TLS switch
Administrator step and the switching state do not reveal secrets
limits: Isolated local control, PG18 and Redis8. Production was already initialized, so this review is not a production first-install.
